verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a Python SDK covering conversion, structured extraction, form filling, and pipelines, and a CLI, with runtime confirmation the Python SDK installs and works (probe-rt-1). However there is no evidence anywhere in the pack of an official TypeScript/JS SDK, and no explicit documentation of a typed 'jobs' API surface beyond webhooks/checkpoints. missing for 10: TypeScript SDK existence/docs, explicit typed jobs API SDK coverage, independent corroboration of SDK completeness beyond first-party docs.
